content:
I am pleased to announce that a scope and vision document for the Lean standard library is now available here. This document outlines our plans for the library's development in the coming months and years, focusing on providing robust, verified building blocks for Lean users. Contributions are welcome—please see the call for contributions included in the document for more details.

In the coming weeks, we will be adding a style guide and naming scheme (for the standard library only) as well as a more detailed outline which will contain a roadmap for the Lean FRO's work on the standard library in 2025.
If you have any questions, feel free to send me a direct message here on Zulip. We can discuss this announcement at #general > Lean standard library vision discussion
